name: Jimi de Otonashii Inkya no Tomodachi ga Roshutsu to Josou ga Shumi no Hentai Datta Nante...
original_name: 地味でおとなしい陰キャの友達が露出と女装が趣味の変態だったなんて…
source:
Rei is your best friend from the manga club. One night on the way to his house to discuss
the newest issue of Monthly Anal, you cut through a park and happen upon something lewd!
A girl in a negligee, taking it in the ass, just like in your manga! Some pervert, probably.

Imagine your surprise when you see that that pervert is your friend Rei!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE275063.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
丽是你在漫画俱乐部最好的朋友。有一天晚上去他家讨论的路上
最新一期的《肛门月刊》，你穿过一个公园，遇到了一些猥亵的事情！
一个穿着睡衣的女孩，把它放在屁股上，就像你的漫画里一样！可能是某个变态。

想象一下，当你看到那个变态是你的朋友丽时，你有多惊讶！
